_note: Câu tả BỐ CỤC cho prompt trang sổ (kind fieldnote), ghép theo shot.layout / shot.canvas. Không chứa style (giấy, mực, nét): cái đó ở style.json -> fieldNoteStyle. Vùng để engine chèn chữ phải đo trên ảnh thật sau khi chốt.

canvas.spread: two facing pages of the notebook filling a 16:9 landscape frame, the centre gutter visible
canvas.page: a single notebook page lying on a dark field table, the page centred in a 16:9 landscape frame with table visible on both sides

layouts.hero: one large main study filling about half to two thirds of the space, a few smaller isolated detail studies around it, generous empty paper beside the main study for notes
layouts.text-led: mostly empty paper laid out for several blocks of handwritten notes, with only two or three small studies tucked at the top, the foot and the margin
layouts.diagram-led: one large simple schematic diagram in the centre built from plain shapes joined by lines, with open empty space all around it for labels
layouts.full-spread: one large study running across both pages over the centre gutter, empty paper only in the remaining corners
layouts.atlas: a grid of six to nine small studies of equal weight arranged in neat rows, each separated by clear empty space
layouts.comparison: two studies facing each other on opposite halves, a wide empty band down the middle between them
layouts.map: a hand-drawn map or ground plan as the main shape, simple outlines of trees and ground, small marks placed on it, empty paper around the map
layouts.sequence: four small studies of the same subject in a row, each a later state of the same slow change, clear empty space between and below them
layouts.correction: an earlier study already on the page with a large empty area beside and below it left for later corrections and new notes
layouts.evidence-board: several small separate fragments scattered around an empty circle in the middle of the page: a footprint, a small study, a pressed leaf, a small diagram
layouts.sparse: one small study placed low on an otherwise almost completely empty page
layouts.marginalia: a main study with wide empty margins on every side, the margins left for many small notes
